The ideal $I_{\ell}$ and the truncation ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)$ are independent of the choice of the admissible shape.

11.5. PBW bases for ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)$

The natural quotient map ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{-}(\sigma)\twoheadrightarrow{\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)$ carries the canonical filtration to the truncated shifted twisted Yangian

$\mathrm{F}_{0}({\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma))\subset\mathrm{F}_{1}({\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma))\subset\mathrm{F}_{2}({\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma))\subset\cdots,\qquad\qquad{\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)=\bigcup_{s\geqslant 1}\mathrm{F}_{s}({\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)).$

Similar to previous discussions, we declare the elements $H_{a;i,j}^{(t)}$ and $B_{b,a;i,j}^{(t)}$ in ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)$ to be of degree $t$ and then define $\mathrm{F}_{s}({\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma))$ to be the span of monomials in these elements of total degree $\leqslant s$ . Due to Corollary 8.12 and Corollary 11.14, this is independent of the choice of the admissible shape $\mu$ .

Being a quotient of $\operatorname{gr}^{\prime}{\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{-}(\sigma)$ , the commutative algebra $\operatorname{gr}^{\prime}{\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)$ is generated by the elements $\{\mathsf{f}_{b,a;i,j}^{(r)}\}$ (actually, their image in the truncation) described in Proposition 8.13.

Observe that the baby coproduct $\Delta_{R}$ defined in Theorem 9.2 factors through the quotient and induces a map on the truncation

(11.34)

$\Delta_{R}:{\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)\rightarrow{\mathscr{Y}}_{N,{\ell-2}}^{-}(\dot{\sigma})\otimes\mathrm{U}(\mathfrak{gl}_{t}).$

Similar to AI type, the map (11.34) respects the canonical filtration, inducing a graded algebra homomorphism

(11.35)

$\operatorname{gr}^{\prime}\Delta_{R}:\operatorname{gr}^{\prime}{\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell}^{-}(\sigma)\rightarrow\operatorname{gr}^{\prime}({\mathscr{Y}}_{N,\ell-2}^{-}(\dot{\sigma})\otimes\mathrm{U}(\mathfrak{gl}_{t})).$

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and finite $W$-algebras of classical type
paper.abstract: We introduce parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians of types AI and AII, interpolating between the R-matrix presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. Then we formulate and provide parabolic presentations for the shifted twisted Yangians. We define quotient algebras known as truncated shifted twisted Yangians and equip them with baby comultiplications, generalizing the work of Brundan and Kleshchev. PBW bases for all (truncated) shifted twisted Yangians of type AI and AII are established along the way. Applying the theory of universal equivariant quantizations of conic symplectic singularities we show that the truncated twisted shifted Yangian is isomorphic to the finite $W$-algebra which quantizes a suitable Slodowy slice. This provides a presentation of the finite $W$-algebra associated with every even nilpotent element in type {\sf B} and {\sf C}, as well as every nilpotent element with two Jordan blocks in type {\sf D}. Finally we make a conjecture which would supply presentations in the remaining even cases in type {\sf D}.
